Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 457 AM EST Mon Nov 16 2026
 

- Cloudy skies this morning will clear by this afternoon.

- Dry weather expected area-wide through Thursday with temperatures 
  above normal.

&&

.AVIATION...

A plume of residual lake moisture maintains a dense blanket of MVFR 
stratus across some of the terminals this morning, with borderline IFR 
ceiling at FNT/PTK. These clouds will be slow to erode/lift/scatter, 
with uncertainty as to the exact timing of this happening. Ceilings 
could persist into the late morning hours, especially for the 
southern terminals which are further downwind. Once cloud cover 
decreases, VFR conditions prevail for the remainder of the day and 
overnight hours. West-southwesterly winds to around 10 knots, then a 
bit slower overnight.

For DTW...MVFR ceiling persists until mid-late morning, then VFR 
with westerly winds this evening and overnight.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

*  High for ceiling at or below 5,000 feet through mid morning, 
   then low late morning.
